title: causalbase: Bayesian network structure learning and causal discovery
description: causalbase learns the structure of Bayesian networks from data. It implements greedy equivalence search (GES) and XGES with BDeu, BIC or Gaussian BIC, iterated local search over variable orders, FLOP, hill climbing and tabu search over DAGs, and exact search by dynamic programming or integer programming. Scores and graph routines are compiled with Numba. Structural metrics, XMLBIF input, forward sampling and five benchmark networks are included. fedcausal, which learns from data split across sites, is built on it.
